jobs.prompt:
Attached image 1: the concept sheet of my game "Hold On!" (world 2 "Workshops"). Use it ONLY as a style reference: bright, cheerful hand-painted cartoon game art; warm wood, copper and brass, grey stone, glowing forges, soft steam, big gears and wooden cranes; warm light; soft shading, clean readable shapes. Do NOT copy the sheet's layout, text, logo, UI panels, frames or characters.

Create a FAR BACKGROUND parallax layer for a 2D side-scrolling co-op platformer. Landscape 3:2. Strict side view, level horizon, no perspective floor, no isometric view. No characters, animals or people. No text, letters, logo, UI, frame or watermark. Nothing that looks interactive or walkable: no crates, doors, levers, buttons, flags, hooks, keys, no ropes or chains across the image, no flat platforms in front. Everything is far away and small in scale. Gentle atmospheric haze; colors a bit softer and less contrasty than a foreground, so small bright red, blue, yellow and green characters stay readable in front of it. Neutral white balance, no yellow or sepia tint.
The band between 40% and 80% of the height is only soft haze and distant silhouettes — no bright details there; put the details near the horizon line and in the bottom haze. The bottom edge is soft mist or steam, not ground. No large object touches the left or right edge, so the image can repeat horizontally.
Scene: MORNING. The open yard of the bridge builders' workshops beside a huge unfinished stone viaduct: tall wooden cranes and scaffolding on the viaduct, small workshop houses with chimneys, a big water wheel, soft white steam, blue sky with big clouds, warm sunlight from the upper left.
Composition: top 40% sky with big clouds; the viaduct and cranes as a calm hazy silhouette across the middle; the lower part is soft white steam.
All structures distant and soft, without dark game-object outlines. No foreground terrain or perspective ground. Keep substantial transparent-looking haze across the central gameplay band (this far image itself is fully opaque); no detailed cranes or tall tower forms in the top corners or at either horizontal edge. Any specified hall chains are tiny distant silhouettes contained within the hall, never spanning the frame. Native landscape 3:2.
